title: TLS disabled for client connections in postgres — review required
description: ssl = off makes the server refuse TLS, so client credentials and query results cross the network in clear text. Even inside a private network, that exposes traffic to any host on the same segment. The rule flags the setting; whether the network is trusted is a review decision.
remediation: Set ssl = on with a valid certificate and require hostssl entries in pg_hba.conf.
limitation: Lexical: matches the server setting; a client-side sslmode preference is out of scope.
